name: dev-toolkits
description: Personal Claude Code toolkits for specification work and deliberate technical practice.

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: Turns Claude Code into an interactive coding teacher for deliberate practice. Two session modes over a shared teaching core, with a global spaced-repetition log.

plugins.name: model-picker
plugins.description: Recommends an appropriate Claude or GPT model and effort level for an upcoming task.

plugins.name: telemetry
plugins.description: Per-turn cost reports (transcripts plus Claude Code's own running total) and a two-line status line: model, effort, git, coloured context use, session cost, 5-hour rate limit, and prompt cache state.

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Tools to create a roadmap from a Claude plan with multiple work units, resume the work on fresh agents, and track execution.

plugins.name: spec-driven-development
plugins.description: Document definitions, interview skills and consistency checks for a solo project, from idea to tasks. Human in the loop; implementation is out of scope.
